thread_text:
liz-peopleops: Hey folks — putting together a tiny one-pager managers can drop into 1:1s for goal-setting + mid-cycle check-ins. Want something lightweight, prompts + example phrases. Any must-haves? :seedling:

sam-engineer: Love it. Could we include a quick section for "what success looks like" and one-sentence signals that it's off-track? Makes follow-ups much easier.

maria-hrbp: +1. Also add a calibration note for managers: how to surface examples for calibration and where to log notes for review. Link to comp/ratings timeline would help.

alex-manager: Personally would add a short career stretch question: "what would you try if failure were an option?" Helps with developmental goals. Also a template phrasing for giving balanced feedback.

liz-peopleops: Great. I'll draft and post a doc. Thinking sections: 1) Goal statement (1 line), 2) Success metrics (measurable signals), 3) Risks/blocks, 4) Development stretch, 5) Feedback prompts, 6) Next steps & owner.

doc-bot: Created Google Doc: https://docs.example.com/d/1abcXYZ (Managers: edit access enabled)

sam-engineer: Can you paste the short copy here so teams can grab it quickly in Slack? No need to open doc for a quick start.

liz-peopleops: Sure — quick drop below (feel free to copy):

---
`One-page Goal Conversation Starter (copyable)`

- Goal (1 line): [e.g., "Reduce average inference latency for web endpoints by 20% by EOY"]
- Why it matters: [impact to product / customers / cost] (1 sentence)
- Success signals (pick 2–3):
  - metric: target / baseline (e.g., p95 latency <= 120ms, baseline 160ms)
  - qualitative: fewer customer tickets about slow responses
  - business: +5% conversion on funnel W
- Risks / blockers: [e.g., infra capacity, model regresses on quality]
- Development stretch: [skill or project stretch; e.g., lead a cross-team perf spike]
- Feedback prompts for manager to ask:
  - "What progress are you most proud of so far?"
  - "What would you change if we had unlimited time/resources?"
  - "What support do you need from me this cycle?"
- Next steps / owner / timeline: [clear 1–2 next actions and who owns them]

`Manager sample phrases`
- Positive: "I appreciate how you owned the latency investigation and pulled in infra — that had a measurable impact."
- Coaching: "I noticed the rollout missed the perf gate; can we walk through what happened and plan a remediation together?"
- Development: "Would you want to own the cross-team perf spike to grow your leadership experience?"
---

maria-hrbp: This is solid. Suggest adding: "Note for calibration: paste 2–3 concise examples/events here with dates" — makes calibration docs actionable.

alex-manager: Perfect. Can we add a one-sentence hint about timebox? e.g., "Keep this to 10–15 mins in 1:1s; deeper items go to a follow-up"

liz-peopleops: Added both to the doc and the snippet above. I'll also make a short template card in the manager playbook.

sam-engineer: Thanks! Will use this for our 1:1 tomorrow. :rocket:

liz-peopleops: Awesome — ping me if you want a tailored version for IC vs. Manager goals.

doc-bot: Updated Google Doc: last edited by liz-peopleops at 2026-03-22 16:45 UTC

alex-manager: Quick Q — should managers push filled templates to the calibration folder or keep private until asked?

maria-hrbp: Please push to the calibration folder 2 weeks before calibration window opens. We only require concise bullets/examples; full docs are optional.

liz-peopleops: Noted — will add a reminder in the playbook and an automated calendar ping for managers 2 weeks before cycle close. :calendar:

alex-manager: Thanks everyone — this feels very usable.
